about_the_game:
This is a simulation management game.

You can purchase goods from the store, and couriers will deliver them to your shop.

Click the "Open" sign to start a new day.

Once opened, cat customers will visit your shop. They will request lottery tickets or scratch-offs. Drag the corresponding items to them to fulfill their requests. After completing their purchases, the cats will drop money, which you need to collect.

During downtime, you can buy lottery tickets. Each ticket consists of a six-digit number, with each digit ranging from 0 to 9. Input your chosen numbers into the lottery machine to generate tickets. You can check your purchased tickets in the lottery box. The winning numbers will be announced and rewards settled after closing each day. Payouts depend on how many digits match the winning combination.

During breaks, you can scratch off the coatings on two types of scratch-off tickets available in your shop. Follow each ticket's rules to determine if you've won a prize.

A mysterious figure may offer to assist you. You can exchange money for special tips to increase your chances of winning larger rewards.
